QUOTE: "Binary files are dropped by `lang_parsing_substrate.classify_file` (`filetypes.py`), both from the scanned tree and before every harvest read." and "Symbol parsing is by extension. `harvest.py` maps suffixes to tree-sitter grammars..."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names binary classification, but it never says that extensions can lie about the file's type. It also never names the parse-built front end claiming file types doxygen can't read. It says only that symbol parsing is by extension and that unmatched files are hashed but not parsed.
